limitations: These values use cash purchases of PP&E, a common cash-flow statement line item; they are not identical to management-defined CAPEX that may include finance lease principal.
Amazon is shown at gross purchases of PP&E (USD 77.259B), not net purchases after proceeds and incentives (USD 75.878B).
Microsoft cash purchases of PP&E (USD 39.4B) are shown separately from management CAPEX including finance leases (USD 45.2B).
None of these amounts is AI-only CAPEX. No comparable quarterly AI revenue was identified; no estimate has been substituted.
